Definition: 1 to 29 days past due and rising
Action: Call the borrower and confirm the reason and expected harvest or sales date.
Agree a remedial plan aligned to the next harvest or sales cycle.

Definition: Inflows 25% or more below the same months last year
Action: Visit the business; check volumes, prices and buyer payments.

Definition: Receivable days up 20 or more in 3 months
Action: Confirm offtaker payment status; consider receivables finance.
Review whether the limit matches the seasonal working-capital need.
Assess crop or pasture condition; check insurance; consider rescheduling to the next harvest.

Definition: NDMA-type drought alarm and no insurance
Action: Escalate to agribusiness credit; plan restructuring before arrears build.

Definition: Value-chain price down 10% or more in 3 months
Action: Re-run the cash-flow projection at current prices.

Definition: Margin index down 12% or more in 6 months
Action: Check input-cost pass-through; consider input finance or buyer-linked pricing.

Trigger: Product does not match cash cycle
Definition: Term loan or overdraft on a long seasonal cycle
Action: Restructure to seasonal repayments or a structured product at renewal.

Definition: Largest buyer above 70% of sales, no contract
Action: Obtain buyer contract or assignment of proceeds.
